description: Every WebSocket action of the cost-basis protocol, classified. Writes name the store method that carries them, what P0 did for FUT ledgers, and where the FOP path lands. The contract test fails when cost_basis_ws.SERVER_ACTIONS and this file disagree, or a store method guarded by _get_writable_book is missing here. Both backends mount the same protocol layer. fopStoreMethod names the store method that carries the action for a FOP ledger (null: not a FOP write yet); every store method that opens the FOP write gate must be one of them.
